subject: general
question: In terms of area, India is the ______ largest country in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is __**seventh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** has a total area of **3.29 million square kilometers**, making it the** seventh-largest country** in the world by area.
 
• India is the** second-most populous country** in the world, with a population of over **1.3 billion people.**
 
• India is located in **South Asia** and shares its borders with **Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and Myanmar.**
 
• India has a diverse geography, ranging from the **Himalayan mountains** in the north to the Indian Ocean in the south.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **third-largest country** in the world by area is** China, **which has a total area of **9.6 million square kilometers.**
 
• The **ninth-largest country** in the world by area is **Kazakhstan,** which has a total area of** 2.72 million square kilometers**.
 
• The **sixth-largest country** in the world by area is **Australia,** which has a total area of **7.69 million square kilometers.**
